newsitem.title: USA: Fed refrains from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed refrains from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve refrained from open market operations on Friday, dealers said.
Analysts, citing the soft Fed funds rate, had said the Fed would be likely to refrain from operations.
Fed funds were trading at 5-3/16 percent at the Fed's typical time for operations, below the central bank's 5-1/4 percent target rate.
Analysts expect the Fed to add permanent reserves to the banking system by buying bills, most likely next week. But one analyst said a bill pass could come as soon as this afternoon.
